findings.title: Potential credential or authorization token disclosure in logger call (Token)
findings.impact: Writing tokens, credentials, or raw authorization headers to logs leaks sensitive authentication secrets to log storage and monitoring pipelines.
findings.recommendation: Redact authorization tokens and sensitive credential headers prior to emitting log records.
owasp: A09 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
